page.title: Observatory – al-Marṣad
page.description: The whole graph of the Seerah in one view: people, events, places, stories and one transmission chain, by relationship, time, place, story and transmission. Every claim is proposed and not yet reviewed.
page.nojs: This view needs JavaScript. Every person, event, place and story is also on the reader pages, which work without it:
search.label: Find a person, event, place, story or group
banner.text: Everything here is a proposal. Every claim in the graph is “proposed” and none has been reviewed by a scholar yet, so every mark is drawn with a hatched or speckled texture. Folded detail is one tap away, never removed.
banner.text.plain: Nothing here has been checked by scholars yet. Every mark has a striped texture to show that. Tap any mark to see where it comes from.
here.label: You are here:
scale.period: In the period: {inside}; no date recorded (hollow): {undated}.
canvas.label: Graph view, {frame}: {shown} of {total} items. The text view below describes it.
frames.label: View (morph frame)
morph.label: Blend between views
morph.note: Drag to morph: the same marks move between Relationship, Time, Geography, Stories and Transmission. Positions are worked out in advance and never re-solved.
scrub.note: Dated items outside the period dim. Items with no recorded date are drawn hollow and are never dimmed or placed by guesswork.
presets.label: Vantage point
presets.title: Vantage points
preset.hijrah_abubakr: The Hijrah from Abu Bakr's side
preset.hijrah_abubakr.about: Abu Bakr in focus, with the Hijrah events and stories and the people the graph ties to both. Found by name in the graph.
preset.badr.about: Everyone the graph records at Badr (the battle, its story, the army, the place). Absences recorded as “absent from” are left out.
preset.first_believers.about: The story of the first believers and the people it names.
preset.family.about: Kinship claims around the Prophet ﷺ: spouses, children and siblings as the graph records them. Only kinship lines are lit.
preset.chain.about: The only transmission chain in the graph so far: the worked example for the report of the cave of Thawr.
keys.help: Keys: arrows pan · + and − zoom · 0 fits · Enter focuses the mark at the centre · Esc steps back · / finds a name.
legend.title: Legend: what every mark means
legend.types_note: Press a type to hide or show it.
legend.class.spatial: took place at, migrated to, died at
legend.texture_text: A hatched mark or speckled line means the record is proposed and not yet reviewed by a scholar. Today that is every mark: no claim has been reviewed.
legend.size: Size: off. No mark is sized by any measure, so nothing reads as rank.
legend.glow: Glow: none. Light is not used for decoration.
legend.motion: Motion: only when you change the view; nothing drifts on its own.
legend.position: Position: the active view (or a blend of views); dimmed marks are outside the focus, thread or period.
legend.prophet: The Prophet ﷺ is named with ﷺ and drawn like every other person: never ranked or emphasised by a computed measure.
legend.basemap: Geography has no basemap yet: only a grid of degrees and the places whose coordinates are recorded.
status.none.plain: a note in the record, not yet a claim
coverage.explain.stub: A stub is little more than a name, and has not been reviewed by a scholar.
coverage.explain.outline: An outline records some facts, but the record is not yet sourced.
coverage.explain.sourced: Its facts point to sources, but a scholar has not yet reviewed them.
coverage.explain.reviewed: A scholar has reviewed this record.
coverage.explain.none: The graph records no coverage state for this record.
panel.label: Details
panel.no_date_person: No dated event and no life date recorded: this person is not on the time axis.
panel.time_from_events: On the time axis by {n} recorded date(s) (dated events they took part in, or a recorded death). Gaps between them are left empty.
panel.no_coords: No coordinates recorded, so it is not on the map.
panel.on_map: On the map at {place}: the located place recorded most often for it. Every recorded place is listed here.
panel.off_map: Not on the map: no place with coordinates is recorded for it.
facet.stories_note: From the 50 Stories document: AI-generated, not yet reviewed.
ladder.intro: {n} claim(s) or record(s) join these two. Each step down the ladder is optional.
ladder.status_note: Proposed by a person or a program; no scholar has reviewed it.
ladder.status_none: This link is a field of the record (a participation or a place), not a separate claim, so it carries no status of its own.
ladder.status_none_chain: A link of a transmission chain from a worked example; the graph records no review status for it.
ladder.no_passage: No source passage is attached to this claim.
ladder.chain_note: {label} — a worked example, not yet reviewed.
ladder.chain_collector: collected by (no link recorded between these two)
ladder.not_yet_all: Reports, chains, manuscript images, gradings and disputes for this claim: none recorded yet. They arrive with the reports of Ibn Hishām's Sīra.
ladder.not_yet_some: Manuscript images and recorded disputes: none yet for this claim.
ladder.claims_count: {n} claim(s) or record(s) touch it. The first ones are open; every one has its own ladder.
trace.title: Trace a thread
trace.intro: Pick two items. The graph finds the shortest threads between them; every step names the claim it rests on and its status.
trace.pick_both: Choose both ends from the list of names.
trace.picking: From {name}: now tap or click another mark, or type its name in “To”.
trace.none: No thread joins {a} and {b} in the graph as it stands.
trace.rank_note: Ordered by how much of each step is a recorded claim with a source; every step is still proposed and unreviewed.
trace.copy_link: Copy a link to this thread
intro.title: One graph, five views
intro.how: Tap or click any mark to focus it: its relationships, events, places, stories, generation and evidence appear here together. Change the view below the picture, scrub a period, or start from a vantage point.
reality.title: What the graph holds today
reality.records: {n} further links are fields of a record (participations, event places, part-of, chain links) with no status of their own.
reality.dates: {dated} of {events} events have recorded dates; stories have none.
reality.chains: {n} transmission chain ({links} links): the worked example of the cave of Thawr. This view grows with the reports of Ibn Hishām's Sīra.
reality.never: Nothing is invented to fill a gap: no date, place, chain or name is guessed, and nothing is interpolated across unknowns.
research.title: Research
research.viewstate_note: This view as data (docs/04 §6). The page address carries it too, so the view can be cited and reopened against this corpus version.
research.copy_link: Copy a link to this view
announce.ladder: Evidence for the link between {a} and {b}.
announce.pick: Tracing from {name}. Choose the other end.
textalt.title: Text view of this picture
textalt.loading: The text view is written from the current view once the page has loaded.
textalt.summary: {frame} view, {lens} lens. It shows {shown} of {total} items ({kinds}) and {links} links.
textalt.nothing_hidden: Nothing is hidden by a filter.
textalt.period: Period {y0}–{y1} CE: {inside} dated items overlap it, {outside} dated items fall outside and are dimmed, {undated} have no recorded date and are drawn hollow.
textalt.status: All {n} claims are proposed; none has been reviewed by a scholar.
textalt.frame.network: Relationship view: items placed by a fixed force layout of the recorded links.
textalt.frame.time: Time view: dated items placed by their recorded date ranges, in lanes by type.
textalt.frame.geo: Geography view: places with recorded coordinates on a grid of degrees, with the events and people recorded at them.
textalt.frame.stories: Stories view: the 50 Stories on a dial in reading order, grouped by part, with the people and groups they name inside it.
textalt.frame.isnad: Transmission view: the one recorded chain, narrator by narrator.
textalt.region.network.main: {n} items have at least one link.
textalt.region.network.shelf: {n} items have no recorded link and sit on the shelf below.
textalt.region.time.axis: {n} items are on the time axis.
textalt.region.time.band: {n} people have a generation (ṭabaqa) but no date, in the generation band.
textalt.region.time.shelf: {n} items have no recorded date and are on the “no date recorded” shelf.
textalt.region.geo.shelf: {n} items have no located place and are on the “no place recorded” shelf.
textalt.region.stories.dial: {n} items are stories or appear in one.
textalt.region.isnad.shelf: {n} items are in no recorded chain yet.
textalt.all_items: Every item in this view, as a list ({n})
footer.built: Built from the unified graph. The reader pages carry the same records without JavaScript.
frame.network.parts: Parts of the graph not linked to the rest
frame.time.axis_title: Recorded date ranges (Gregorian years; each bar is a recorded range, not a point)
frame.time.lane_people: People, at the dated events they took part in (gaps left empty)
frame.time.band_title: Generation (ṭabaqa) recorded, no date: not on the time axis
frame.time.band_note: Ordered by generation only; no year is implied.
frame.geo.title: Places with recorded coordinates
frame.geo.note: Equirectangular projection; grid lines every degree. No basemap: coastlines and terrain are not drawn.
frame.geo.shelf: No place recorded (or no coordinates for it)
frame.stories.title: The 50 Stories, in reading order, by part
frame.stories.note: An AI-generated document, not yet reviewed. People and groups sit inside the dial near the stories that name them.
frame.isnad.title: Transmission (isnād)
frame.isnad.note: {n} chain recorded so far: the worked example for the report of the Hijrah (Ghār Thawr).
frame.isnad.grows: This view is the start of a feature: it grows as the reports of Ibn Hishām's Sīra are added.
frame.isnad.no_line: no link recorded to the narrator above
date.converted: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} days
date.converted_one: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} day
date.converted_plain: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date
date.relative: Dated relative to another event or period; no date is worked out here
